rule: Mover has only its Kernel. Enumerate all Kernel lines of the remaining actions (8 or 8x8, incl. attack-redirect on a guarded enemy Kernel); no line captures the enemy Kernel, at least one line exists, and every line ends in losing_final = bare-Kernel resolution lost | shrink-after-our-turn kills our K (not theirs) | enemy R1/R2 kill on the (shrunk) board | Cyan mover with K on the next ring and enemy K able to shuffle.

g2, plus for actions_left == 1 with own non-Kernel pieces: enumerate all 76 fixed (piece type, offset) action slots exactly as rules.py; no slot wins, some slot is legal, and every legal slot's successor satisfies losing_final (EW level 3).

g3, plus for actions_left == 2 with own non-Kernel pieces: for every legal first action slot (none winning, at least one legal) the successor satisfies the actions_left == 1 one-ply certificate (76 x 76 slots).

g4, with losing_final also accepting EBK: the enemy has only its Kernel, we have <= 1 non-Kernel piece, and the enemy Kernel's two actions (capturing that piece if any) end where the bare-Kernels resolution at the end of the enemy's turn goes to the enemy (Chebyshev > 2 and smaller ring, or equal ring with the enemy real Magenta).
